Die 3D-Ansicht ist das, was du jeden Tag: The 3D view is what you use every day: your home live, to look at and to control.
In dieser Folge zeige ich dir jeden Knop: In this episode I show you every button and every switch in it.
Folge 10 hat zwei Teile. In Teil 1 geht: Episode 10 has two parts. Part 1 is about getting around and about all the switches of the view.
Teil 2 zeigt das Bedienen: Lampen und Ro: Part 2 is about controlling things: lamps and blinds, the room panel, the star, the search, warnings and start views. I'm using the demo house from the online demo.
Oben auf „3D“ siehst du zuerst das ganze: At the top, on “3D”, you first see the whole house. Every floor has a label: how many rooms and how many lights are on right now.
Ziehen dreht die Ansicht, das Mausrad od: Dragging turns the view, the mouse wheel or two fingers zoom.
Ein Tipp auf die Beschriftung öffnet die: A tap on the label opens the floor. The floors above fly away.
Ein Tipp auf einen Raum fliegt hinein, u: A tap on a room flies into it, and the room panel opens on the right – more about it in part 2.
Eine Ebene höher geht es mit Esc, mit „Z: You go up one level with Esc, with “Back” – in German „Zurück“ – at the bottom …
… oder mit einem Doppeltipp auf eine fre: … or with a double tap on an empty spot.
Links stehen die Etagenbilder. Ein Tipp: On the left are the floor pictures. A tap jumps straight to a floor, the house above them shows all floors again.
Der kleine Pfeil darüber klappt sie zu s: The small arrow above them folds them into plain buttons – and back. The device remembers that.
Oben in der Leiste stehen alle Etagen un: The bar at the top lists all floors and the rooms. In the house view each floor's rooms come after its name.
Passen nicht alle in eine Zeile, scrollt: If they don't fit into one row, the bar scrolls sideways, on a PC with the mouse wheel. The button on the right wraps it onto several rows, a second tap brings back the single row.
Unten liegen die Schalter. „Wände hoch“: The switches are at the bottom. “Tall walls” – „Wände hoch“ – shows the walls at full height; the front ones turn into tinted glass so you can still see inside.
„Schnitt“ schneidet alle Wände auf Hüfth: “Cut” – „Schnitt“ – cuts all walls at hip height. Tall furniture like wardrobes, stairs or tall cabinets is cut as well, so it doesn't hide anything behind it.
Die Wahl merkt sich jedes Gerät: Das Wan: Every device remembers its choice: the wall tablet may show the cut, the phone the tall walls.
In der Hausansicht kommen zwei Schalter: The house view adds two switches. “Apart” – „Auseinander“ – pulls the floors apart, “Stacked” – „Gestapelt“ – puts them on top of each other like the real house.
Normalerweise hebt sich das Dach beim He: Normally the roof lifts and fades out as you zoom in, so you can look into the house.
Mit „Dach bleibt“ bleibt es liegen – gut: With “Roof stays” – „Dach bleibt“ – it stays in place. Handy when you want to show the house from outside, say the roof with the solar panels.
Ist eine Etage offen, wählst du, was mit: With a floor open, you choose what happens to the floors below: “Dimmed” – „Abgedunkelt“ …
… „Gestapelt“ – das ganze Haus bis hier: … “Stacked” – the whole house up to here – or “Single” – „Einzeln“ – just this one floor.
Die nächste Gruppe ist die Heatmap. „Tem: The next group is the heatmap. “Temp.” colours the floors by the temperature in the room, the colour scale is at the edge.
Es zählen die Sensoren im Bereich des Ra: It uses the sensors in the room's area. The unit comes from Home Assistant, Celsius or Fahrenheit, and is converted correctly.
„Feuchte“ und „CO2“ funktionieren genaus: “Humidity” – „Feuchte“ – and “CO2” work the same way. If no room has such a sensor, the scale says so.
„Werte“ färbt nichts, sondern schreibt T: “Values” – „Werte“ – colours nothing; it writes temperature, humidity and CO2 as numbers under the room names.
„Raumnamen“ blendet die Namen der Räume: “Room names” – „Raumnamen“ – hides the room names and shows them again – for a calm picture on the wall.
„Spur“ und „Kameras“ gehören zur Erweite: “Trail” and “Cameras” – „Spur“ and „Kameras“ – belong to the Camera Cockpit extension, “Weather” – „Wetter“ – to Outdoor Weather. Without the extension there's a lock in front of them.
The view options are at the top right. First the quality: “Auto” chooses by itself.
„Tablet“ lässt Muster, Schatten und Lich: “Tablet” leaves out patterns, shadows and halos. It's the lightest level, and on Fire tablets it's chosen automatically.
„Hoch“ zeigt zusätzlich Lichtkegel unter: “High” – „Hoch“ – also shows light cones under the spots, like here in the bathroom.
Daneben der Look: „Neon“ ist der Standar: Next to it is the look: “Neon” is the default, “Blueprint” looks like a construction plan, and “Day” – „Tag“ – shows the house bright.
Das Farbfeld daneben setzt deine eigene: The colour field next to it sets your own accent colour. In the Neon look, lines and glowing edges take it on, buttons and pins in every look.
Der Pfeil daneben bringt das Cyan zurück: The arrow next to it brings back the cyan.
„Symbole“ bestimmt, welche Gerätesymbole: “Symbols” – „Symbole“ – decides which device symbols appear. “All” – „Alle“ – shows every device …
„Wichtige“ nur Geräte ohne eigenes 3D-Mo: … “Important” – „Wichtige“ – only devices without their own 3D model, and values like watts or the running app. “None” – „Keine“ – hides them.
Die zwei Knöpfe mit den halben Kästchen: The two buttons with the half squares put the floor pictures, the star, the search and the eye on the left or on the right – handy when the view sits at the left edge of the dashboard.
Das Fadenkreuz heißt „Ansicht halten“: W: The crosshair is called “Keep view” – „Ansicht halten“: when you switch floors, the camera stays where it is, only the height moves along.
„FPS“ zeigt unten rechts die Bildrate, d: “FPS” shows the frame rate at the bottom right, the slowest frame and the reason for every frame drawn.
In Ruhe steht dort null Bilder pro Sekun: At rest it says zero frames per second: NeonPlan only draws when something changes. That's why it also runs on old wall tablets.
Ganz rechts steht die installierte Versi: The installed version is on the far right. On a phone, a gear folds these options open and closed.
Unten links, neben der Lupe, sitzt das A: At the bottom left, next to the magnifier, sits the eye. One tap hides everything that isn't the 3D view: header, bars, floor pictures and switches.
Auch die Energiewerte oben links verschw: The energy values at the top left disappear too – they come from the Energie Pro extension.
Ein Raum lässt sich weiter antippen, und: You can still tap a room, and a tap on the eye brings everything back. Every device remembers this choice too, like all the switches.
Das waren Haus, Etage und Raum und alle: That was house, floor and room, and all the switches of the view.
